biography: Seb Morris, a name now whispered with a mix of excitement and trepidation in British racing circles, didn't exactly inherit a silver spoon. Hailing from a small town known more for its sheep than speed, Seb's entry into motorsports was almost accidental. He initially worked as a mechanic's assistant at a local garage that catered to a surprisingly vibrant amateur racing scene. One fateful Saturday, a driver for a Caterham 620R team fell ill, and Seb, who knew the car inside and out, was offered a chance. He stunned everyone, including himself, by qualifying mid-pack and finishing respectably. From that moment, grease-stained hands transitioned to gripping a steering wheel. His flashy style, both on and off the track, has quickly made him a polarizing figure, but undeniable talent keeps him climbing. While he’s still a rising star, Seb’s aggressive maneuvers and unpredictable overtakes are marking him as one to watch. Currently, he is competing in the Caterham 620R series, aiming to prove he has what it takes to move to bigger and faster machines.
drivingStyle: Seb's driving style can be best described as 'controlled chaos.' He attacks corners with a ferocity that often sees him flirting with the very edge of grip. Tire management isn't exactly his forte; he prefers to extract every last bit of performance from the tires early on, often sacrificing longevity for immediate gains. Under pressure, he becomes even more aggressive, sometimes leading to spectacular overtakes, other times to costly mistakes. His raw speed is undeniable, but his consistency is still a work in progress. He is a natural risk-taker, often trusting his instincts over calculated strategy.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision during a Caterham 620R race. Seb maintains Marcus intentionally blocked him, while Marcus claims it was simply hard racing.
A constant on-track battle for position, fueled by mutual respect and a healthy dose of competitive spite. Their battles are often the highlight of any race they both enter.

Alistair, the 'establishment' driver with a perfect racing pedigree, publicly criticized Seb's 'unsportsmanlike' driving style. Seb responded with an on-track demonstration of his skills, further igniting the rivalry.

quirks: Always wears a lucky pair of red socks, even if they clash horribly with his race suit.
Listens to heavy metal music at an ear-splitting volume right up until the moment he gets into the car.
Has a habit of talking to his car before each race, thanking it for its service and promising to 'drive it like he stole it.'
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing it safe; it's about pushing limits. If you're not on the edge, you're taking up too much space."
careerHighlight: Winning the Caterham 620R Championship race at Brands Hatch in 2022. He battled from the back of the grid after a qualifying penalty, showcasing his overtaking prowess and securing his first major victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Oulton Park race in 2021. A momentary lapse in concentration saw him clip the curb, sending him spinning into the barrier and costing him a likely victory.
